visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Dropdown hidden behind the content
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The menu is meant to open on top of the text but it is drawn behind it. The text paragraph has a higher stacking order than the menu.
visualizerParams.buggyCode: Text under the menu, long enough to overlap it.

solution.code: Text under the menu, long enough to overlap it.
solution.explanation: Positioned elements are drawn in the order of their z-index, so the larger number is in front. The menu needs a larger value than the text it should cover.

checks.label: The menu is drawn in front of the text
checks.expr: (() => { var m = el('.menu').getBoundingClientRect(); return document.elementFromPoint(m.left + 20, m.top + 40) === el('.menu'); })()
